title: Scenario scorer: narrow the bare-name Build check and the build prompt's naming rule to bucket-1 types and positions (ADR-0150 hand-off, with or before #31669)
body:
epic:#3600#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPXwX1YfHyKJUh4agu

Filing-gate category: ② execution of a maintainer ruling, handed to this seat by ADR-0150 (merged in #31586). The maintainer's turn to package-scoped addressing, verbatim: 「你不能只考虑现状，还要考虑长远的合理性；我说的流程不是url挂到对象下，而是挂到软件包下」 (decision card A 「转向包寻址」, record 6721941146 on #30806). ADR-0150 D9 and its "Hand-off outside this epic" line: "the scenario scorer's `bare-name` Build check and build prompt narrowed to bucket 1 types and positions … filed by the cloud#3600 epic seat to the lane that owns the scorer, with or before P". Child P is #31669. Routing, verbatim: 「能交给车队开发的你不要自己开发」. Epic: objectstack-ai/cloud#3600.

## Problem

Under ruling C (now withdrawn for non-object types), #30795 made the scorer fail every non-object item named without `NS_`, in `gradeItemNames` (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-naming.ts`). `src/runner/prompts.ts` tells the agent to prefix every item. ADR-0150 keys bucket 2–4 types (flows, actions, jobs, tools, skills, agents, connectors, …) by (package, name). A faithful build that names them bare must now pass, and must not be refused gallery export for it.

## Ask

1. Narrow the `bare-name` Build check to **bucket 1 types and positions** (ADR-0150 D1 and D7: a position keeps one environment-wide slot per name). Of the collections the scorer walks, **view, doc and capability keep the check**, the capability matched by its `NS.SHORT` spelling. An api item's `name` is bucket 2 and passes. Read the bucket of each type from the platform's own source once child P / R export it, never from a restated list. Until then, cite ADR-0150 D1's table in a comment and pin it with a test that fails when that table changes.
2. Narrow the build and iterate prompts' naming rule to the same set: objects plus the bucket-1 types and positions carry the namespace; behavioural types are named plainly.
3. **Land with or before #31669 (child P)**, so the scorer, the skills and the templates never teach different rules. Post `Notify: serial` to P's seat if needed.
4. Tests: a bare flow, action, tool and job name passes; a bare position and view still fail; a capability without `NS.SHORT` fails.

This narrows a scoring rule only. It loosens no platform resolution (ADR-0150 red line 1).

Reader: the `domain:devx` lane seat, from `pm:queue`.
